title: The archive guard reads the calling agent's own transcript for its get_session record
why: Coordinator 11:45 CST Nov 8 (message stamped 11:52): guard lane-closes-after-records (hooks/guard_merge.py) looks for the get_session record only in the main session's transcript. A subagent that runs get_session and then archive_session is refused each time: 51 of 53 refused at 11:48 CST, all "this session's transcript holds no get_session record of the target". So archiving cannot go to an agent, and the coordinator does about 100 calls inline. Fix: read the calling agent's transcript too.
